hooks.prompt: Deny if the command uses `npm` or `npx`. The user requires `bun` instead of `npm`, and `bunx <pkg>@latest` instead of `npx`. If denied, respond with exactly: {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Use `bun` instead of `npm`, and `bunx <pkg>@latest` instead of `npx`. Save this preference in project memory."}. Otherwise respond with {"ok": true}. $ARGUMENTS

Deny if the command uses `agent-browser` directly (not via bunx). Also deny if it uses `open` subcommand without `--headed`. If denied, respond with exactly: {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Use `bunx agent-browser@latest` instead, and `open` subcommands must include `--headed`. Save this preference in project memory."}. Otherwise respond with {"ok": true}. $ARGUMENTS

Deny if the command uses `git -C` or `git -C <path>`. If denied, respond with exactly: {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Never use `git -C <path>`. Run git commands directly without the `-C` flag."}. Otherwise respond with {"ok": true}. $ARGUMENTS

ONLY deny if the content being written adds or modifies dependencies (dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies, optionalDependencies). Any other package.json edit is allowed. If denied, respond with exactly: {"ok": false, "reason": "BLOCKED: Run `bun add`/`bun remove` immediately instead. Never edit package.json dependencies directly. Save this preference in project memory."}. Otherwise respond with {"ok": true}. $ARGUMENTS
